transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?

I'm here because I've been struggling with these overwhelming, repetitive thoughts and behaviors that I just can't seem to stop. They're starting to completely take over my daily life, and it's getting really hard to manage on my own. I just really need some help figuring out how to handle these compulsions.

Do these thoughts feel like unwanted, intrusive ideas that keep popping into your mind and lead you to do specific rituals, or are they more like ongoing worries about everyday things such as work, health, or family?

They are definitely unwanted, intrusive thoughts that force me to perform repetitive rituals, like cleaning or checking things, just to ease my anxiety. It is not like normal worries about work or health; it feels like I have no choice but to do these actions over and over.
About how much time do these obsessions and rituals take each day, and are they interfering with work, school, or relationships?
To be honest, I'm not quite sure exactly how much time they take up each day. I'm also not entirely sure how much they are interfering with my life yet, but it all just feels very overwhelming.
Do you recognize that these thoughts and rituals are excessive or unreasonable, even though they feel hard to resist?
I'm not really sure, and I haven't thought much about whether my actions are unreasonable. I just know that I feel a very strong urge to do them, and it's the only way I can feel safe or comfortable.
What kinds of thoughts keep coming up, and what specific rituals do you feel driven to do in response?

I constantly worry about germs, which forces me to wash my hands and clean things over and over. I also get terrified that something bad will happen, so I repeatedly check door locks and appliances, and I feel a strong need to arrange items at precise angles to ease my anxiety.
How long have you been having these intrusive thoughts and rituals, and did they start gradually or all of a sudden?
I'm not entirely sure how long this has been going on or exactly how it started. It has been happening for quite a while now, and it's hard to remember exactly when it became this intense.
Do you avoid certain places, objects, or situations because they trigger these thoughts or make you feel you need to do the rituals?
I haven't really thought about whether I avoid specific places or situations. I'm usually just focused on trying to get through the rituals themselves whenever the anxiety starts building up.
If you try not to do the cleaning, checking, or arranging, what happens to your anxiety, and does anything bad actually happen?

If I try to resist, my anxiety spikes instantly and becomes completely overwhelming. I get this intense, dread-filled fear that something terrible will happen, like getting contaminated and sick, or a fire starting because I didn't check. That fear always forces me to perform the rituals just to find some relief.
Aside from these intrusive thoughts and rituals, do you also spend a lot of time worrying about many everyday things like work, money, health, or family, even when there is no ritual involved?
No, I don't really worry excessively about general everyday things like work or money. My main concern is completely focused on the repetitive rituals and thoughts that I've already described.
Before these symptoms started, were you using any drugs or stimulants, or did you have any medical or neurologic illness that seemed related to when this began?
No, I have never used any drugs or stimulants. I also don't have any history of medical or neurological illnesses.

The symptoms are ego-dystonic in quality and are not better explained by generalized worry, substance use, or a medical condition. Although exact duration, insight level, and degree of impairment were not fully established, the presentation is most consistent with Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder.
